A sovereign reference architecture for a mining company's high consequence tailings storage facility in the United States: one governed facility ontology of fifteen objects over eight read only systems of record, three drafting agents whose drafts the tailings engineer and the engineer of record confirm, and gpt-oss-120b self hosted on one node of eight 80 GB GPUs in the site server room.
write_paths: the adapter tier (the telemetry adapter for the historian's live feed and the integration adapter for the seven document, plan, model and correspondence sources, read only against the eight systems of record, every source entering with its provenance class and read direction recorded)

the recorded human decision: a confirmed or rejected pattern draft, an approved response draft and an engineer of record approval on a regulator submission, written into the object model and the memory of confirmed patterns and never into any system of record

the surfaces used by the named tailings engineer, the responsible tailings facility engineer and the engineer of record (identity served on site): pattern confirmations, response approvals and submission approvals; the review board and the regulator read through read only views
human_loop: agents draft and engineers decide: the pattern agent's draft is confirmed by the tailings engineer, the response agent's draft is approved by the responsible tailings facility engineer, and the reporting agent's surveillance report and regulator submission are reviewed and approved by the engineer of record; the existing trigger action response plan alarm path keeps firing untouched and no agent changes a threshold, a deposition plan or a submission without a named approval

title: Industrial AI Reference Architecture for an Engine MRO Shop Floor in the United States
summary: Critical Path Watch: Industrial AI in Engine Maintenance on Hardware the Shop Owns. A system design that gives the planners of a United States engine maintenance, repair and overhaul shop serving airlines and lessors one governed model of shop flow, agents that draft while named people decide, on the shop's own hardware with open weights and nothing about the airlines' engines leaving its control.
write_paths: the integration adapter tier (one family, one adapter per source, change data capture and interface reads, read only against the seven systems of record, carrying the source system, record identifier and capture position onto every object it touches)
the agent write back into a system of record, which runs only after a named person approves the draft, with an audit trail

the surfaces used by named planners, materials managers, customer program managers and quality staff (the command center, the approval queue, the vendor queue and the quality queue): confirmations, approvals and the memory of confirmed outcomes
human_loop: agents draft and people decide: the engine planner confirms the critical path draft, the customer program manager approves the workscope cascade, the materials manager approves the vendor chase or the alternative, and no agent changes a workscope, places an order, moves a build slot or notifies an airline without a named approval

title: Industrial AI Reference Architecture for Fertilizer Plant Reliability in Pakistan
summary: Cycle Watch: Sovereign AI Reference Architectures for Plant Reliability in Pakistan. A reference architecture for a fertilizer manufacturer in Pakistan whose ammonia and urea complex is cycled by gas supply suspensions: one governed plant ontology of fourteen objects over eight read only systems of record and a hardware data diode, three drafting agents that named superintendents and engineers confirm, and GLM 5.3 self hosted on one node on the operator's own hardware in the country.
write_paths: the adapter tier (integration, telemetry, ops systems and ERP adapter families, read only against the eight named systems of record and the sensing feeds, crossing the OT boundary through a hardware data diode carrying a one way file transfer, stamping every record with its source system and provenance class)

the confirmation loop above the model: every status change carries a named person and a timestamp, and an agent's output stays a draft until someone with authority confirms it; nothing writes back through the diode and nothing is written into a system of record
the memory of confirmed restart causes and accepted inspections, which every run reads before it acts and which never updates model weights
human_loop: agents draft and people decide, by name: the shift superintendent confirms every step of the restart plan, the reliability engineer approves the cycle damage draft and the inspections it brings forward, and the turnaround manager approves the scope additions; the standing written procedure stays the restart authority until measured agreement, and no agent writes to the control system

title: Physical AI System Design for a Mobile Robot Fulfilment Centre in Saudi Arabia
summary: Robot Field Watch: Physical AI for Warehouse Robot Safety at Every Gate, Pick Front and Charging Bay. A sovereign physical AI system that detects people inside the robot field, fallen totes and blocked lanes on the cameras a robotic fulfilment centre in Saudi Arabia already runs, and drafts the zone slowdowns, clearance tasks and handovers that supervisors approve.
write_paths: the adapter tier (one family of read only integration adapters: change data capture for the transactional systems and stream ingest for the cameras, every message stamped with source, time and adapter version)

the approvals service: the recorded approval or rejection of an agent draft with its logged reasoning, written into the object model and the memory, never into any system of record and never into the fleet

the surfaces used by named shift supervisors, the fleet controller and the operations manager (identity served by the on site Keycloak): zone slow down approvals, clearance task and reroute request approvals, and handover confirmations
human_loop: agents detect and draft and people decide: the incursion agent's zone slow down and supervisor call is approved by the shift supervisor, the stall agent's clearance task and reroute request by the fleet controller, and the shift agent's handover is confirmed by the operations manager; execution is manual, no agent drives a robot or issues a motion command, and known answer probes on the review queue measure whether approvers are rubber stamping

title: Sovereign AI Reference Architectures for a Remote Mine on a Satellite Link in Pakistan
summary: Mining Watch: One Living Picture of the Operation. A sovereign reference architecture for a remote copper and gold mine on a satellite link in Pakistan: one governed site ontology of fifteen objects over read mirrors of seven systems of record, three drafting agents that named supervisors approve, memory that survives crew rotation, and GLM 5.3 self hosted on one node inside the fence that answers with the link down.
write_paths: the adapter tier (the integration adapter for record extracts and the telemetry adapter for tag and telematics streams), read only against the seven site systems through local mirrors, stamping every fact with its source system and the time the site last saw it

the recorded confirmation of a draft by a named person, made inside the owning system's own procedure and reconciled daily against that system's record during the pilot; never a second version of permit state beside the permit to work system
the store and forward sync across the satellite link: mirror refreshes in and chosen operational aggregates out, in stored order with idempotent replay, never the camp and workforce mirror
human_loop: agents draft and supervisors decide, by name: the area supervisor confirms the permit agent's shift start draft of open permits, conflicts and expired isolations per pad; the maintenance planner approves the equipment agent's work order draft and its parts check; the logistics lead approves the convoy agent's re sequencing when a convoy runs late; no agent issues a permit, closes an isolation or dispatches a convoy, and the mine manager's statutory authority is untouched

title: A Self-Improving AI System for Carrier Exception Handling in the United States
summary: Lane Memory: A Sovereign AI Reference Architecture for Self-Improving Carrier Exception Handling in Supply Chain and Logistics. A self-improving AI system for a third party logistics provider in the United States: one governed freight ontology of sixteen objects over seven read only systems and the working threads, three drafting agents that named coordinators confirm, memory that compounds from every confirmed outcome, and GLM 5.3 self hosted on one node in the operator's own facility.
keywords: truckload and less than truckload freight
write_paths: the adapter tier (one integration adapter family: change capture on the transactional systems, governed pulls on the feeds and threads, read only against the seven sources, carrying provenance, ordering, scope and conformity on every record)
the approved appointment change request, written from the action object into the scheduling tool's request surface only after a named coordinator's approval, the one operational write in the design
the recorded confirmation, approval, resolution and standing fix, written into the object model and the memory service and never into any other system of record
the carrier message and the shipper notice, sent through email on the action object's approved path and never before approval
human_loop: agents draft and coordinators decide: the triage agent's type, cause, cascade and matching past resolution are confirmed by the exception coordinator; the recovery agent's carrier message, appointment change request and shipper notice are approved by the coordinator; the review agent's recurring exceptions and proposed standing fix are approved by the operations manager; every approver is recorded on the action object, confirmations are tested with known answer probes and a weekly sample, and no agent re tenders a load, changes an appointment or sends a notice on its own

title: A Self-Improving AI System for Canal Irrigation Water Allocation in Pakistan
summary: Canal Share Ledger: Ontologies for Canal Water Allocation Across the Rotation. A sovereign reference architecture for a provincial irrigation department in Pakistan: one governed canal ontology of sixteen objects over eight read only sources, three drafting agents for shortfall, indent and dispute that named engineers confirm, memory in place of training, and open weights self hosted in the department's own circle server room.
write_paths: the adapter tier (a telemetry adapter doing a direct historian read, and an integration adapter running the OCR pipeline over the paper sources with a human verification stage and a 2 percent failure gate on every batch), read only against the eight sources, stamping every item with source system, adapter, timestamp and verification state
the confirmation at a surface, the single write path into the object model, written into the model and the memory of confirmed causes and accepted adjustments and never into a system of record

the three surfaces used by named engineers and officers (identity issued on site): shortfall draft review with gate adjustment confirmation, indent approval before submission to the national authority, and cited dispute account drafts
human_loop: agents draft and people decide: the controlling engineer confirms or rejects the drafted cause and correction before any gate instruction is drafted, the indent draft is approved before it goes to the national authority, and the dispute account is drafted from cited records for the officer to send; no agent operates a gate, which stays a hand operation on telephone instructions under the department's own procedures

title: Physical AI System Design for Weld and Assembly Quality in a Vehicle Plant in Pakistan
summary: Discrete Manufacturing & Automotive Watch: One Living Picture of the Operation. A sovereign reference architecture for a vehicle assembly plant in Pakistan: triggered cameras and edge units at the station exits checking every body, one governed plant ontology of sixteen objects over six read only sources, three agents that named inspectors and managers confirm, and GLM 5.3 self hosted on one node in the plant's own server room.
write_paths: the integration adapter family (Debezium change data capture from the MES and QMS databases, collectors for controller and rig logs, one way transfer out of a network zone), read only against the six sources, with identity resolved once in the ontology and every event stamped from the PTP grandmaster
the station edge units, which write detections, evidence frames and ontology records across the plant backbone and keep only the result and the evidence frame
the approved record, the single write path back into a system of record: confirmed findings flow to the quality management system through the adapter, never around it

the surfaces used by the named body shop quality inspector and quality manager (identities issued inside the plant network): station confirmations, repair ticket approvals and corrective action approvals
human_loop: agents check and draft, people decide: a flagged weld point or missing clip is a Defect in the state Flagged until the body shop quality inspector moves it to Confirmed or Dismissed at the station terminal; a repair ticket exists in Draft until the quality manager approves it; a corrective action opens only under the quality manager's authority; no agent stops a line or rejects a supplier lot
